subject: Media Literacy
title: The Future of Digital Privacy
description: A fast breakdown of The Future of Digital Privacy for builders.

hook.text: A new law gives users ownership of their data. A new technology makes surveillance invisible. The race continues.

buildup.text: The future of privacy depends on the tension between technology, legislation, corporate power, and public awareness.

discovery.text: Promising developments include privacy-by-design, decentralized systems, and growing public demand for data rights.

twist.text: But AI, biometrics, and IoT are making surveillance more powerful faster than laws can create protections.

climax.text: Privacy won't be saved by technology or law alone. It requires informed citizens who demand and defend it.

punchline.text: Privacy isn't something you have. It's something you fight for. Every day.

quiz.question: What is essential for protecting digital privacy in the future?
options: Informed citizens who demand and defend privacy rights
